## Not affected or duplicate

| Finding | Project | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [circle-usdc-permit-code-first](../findings/circle-usdc-permit-code-first.md) | circle | not-affected | Circle USDC: permit and transfer-with-authorization check account code first and pass full-length signatures to ERC-1271; no exposure beyond each holder's own key |
| [cow-aave-adapter-order-code-first](../findings/cow-aave-adapter-order-code-first.md) | aave | not-affected | Aave Labs' Aave V3 × CoW flash-loan adapter factory checks account code before ECDSA; a quantum attacker gains nothing beyond each EOA's own key |
| [unidentified-380ff867-signer-key](../findings/unidentified-380ff867-signer-key.md) | unidentified-380ff867 | not-affected | Unidentified 7702 execution cosigner (0x380ff867): its service ECDSA key only cosigns, and each execution also needs the delegated EOA's own signature, so forging the service key takes nothing; not affected beyond the account's own key |
| [unidentified-3d011bbb-snark-verifier](../findings/unidentified-3d011bbb-snark-verifier.md) | unidentified-3d011bbb | not-affected | Not affected: EOA 0x3d011bbb… only sent plain ETH transfers to precompile addresses; no SNARK verification |
| [unidentified-c6fd8084-p256](../findings/unidentified-c6fd8084-p256.md) | unidentified-c6fd8084 | not-affected | Address-poisoning batch contract 0xc6fd8084: its calls to the P-256 precompile are a calldata-parsing artefact; it verifies no signature (not affected) |
| [unidentified-e11be20b-signer-key](../findings/unidentified-e11be20b-signer-key.md) | unidentified-e11be20b | not-affected | Unidentified EIP-7702 wallet co-signer verifier 0xe11be20b: requires both the account's own key and a service key, so a recovered service key alone moves nothing |
| [uniswap-permit2-code-first](../findings/uniswap-permit2-code-first.md) | uniswap | not-affected | Uniswap Permit2 (canonical and one copy): signatures from accounts with code go to ERC-1271 with the full signature; no exposure beyond each account's own key |
| [velora-delta-order-code-first](../findings/velora-delta-order-code-first.md) | paraswap | not-affected | Velora Delta (Portikus adapter): user orders are checked through ERC-1271 for accounts with real code, so a post-quantum account is not forgeable here; not affected beyond the account's own key |
